summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. filed a Form 6-K for the month of April 2026, essentially a routine periodic report furnished to the SEC as a foreign private issuer. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change—is disclosed in the filing. The document consists of administrative information and is signed by officers, with no transaction terms, board recommendations, or deal mechanics. As a routine current report, it does not constitute a special situation.
